content: Cross-checking Strong, Hevy, FitNotes, and JEFIT official product/help pages shows that reusable routines or templates, custom workouts, quick set entry for exercise-appropriate values, previous-performance context, warm-up support, notes, and the ability to modify exercises or sets during a workout are established personal gym-tracker expectations. Offline operation is particularly important for gym-floor use but is not universal across account-centric competitors.
